subject: Dedicated capacity commissioning — verification & acceptance
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoood-inference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearwave.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clearwave.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity commissioning — verification & acceptance

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for running yesterday's end-to-end load window with our Dedicated expansion. I pulled the raw traces and attached the main CSV (clearwave-loadtest-20261204.csv) — it contains per-node latency, token throughput, GPU utilization, and KV cache hit rates for the 3x 30-minute windows you ran.

High-level summary: 12 additional GPUs were commissioned into the reserved pool (pool-clarity-prod-us-west). Across the 30–90s sustained queries mix we saw: median p95 token latency 68ms, steady-state throughput ~4.8k tokens/s, and KV cache hit ~82%. There was one ~90s warmup plateau at 02:17:42 UTC where a single node reported transient OOM and recovered via auto-restart (logged).

Proposed acceptance criteria (requested):
- No sustained p95 > 120ms during steady-state windows
- No failed requests >0.05% for the verification period
- Throughput >= 4.5k tokens/s across combined pool for at least two 30-minute windows

If that looks good I will:
1) upload the acceptance checklist and remediation notes (internal)
2) send DocuSign for renewal amendment + capacity addendum
3) enable the 30-day elevated monitoring profile (additional retention and alerting) described in the runbook (link below)

Please review the CSV and tell me either: (a) sign-off as-is, (b) list operational items you want fixed before sign-off, or (c) request a repeat run on your traffic pattern.

Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=runbook_clearwave_commissioning

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Lead, Enterprise Renewals
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: clearwave-loadtest-20261204.csv
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clearwave.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearwave.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-07T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity commissioning — verification & acceptance

Laura — thanks for the quick summary and the CSV. I pulled a few targeted queries and had the eng team skim the metrics. Two quick notes before formal sign-off:

1) Warmup spike: we see the same transient at 02:17:42 UTC; it's reproducible on our ingest-heavy pattern. Can you confirm the auto-restart root cause and whether it can be prevented (or at least reduced) during rolling deploys?
2) Request-level retries: our perimeter logged a ~0.12% retry rate during the first 10 minutes of the burst. That drops to ~0.03% after 2–3 minutes. We want an explicit note in the acceptance checklist that covers acceptable warmup retry behavior.

If you can add the warmup mitigation item and the retry wording, then we're good to sign. I'll need Elena's formal OK for DocuSign after that.

Best,
Tom Nguyen
SRE, ClearWave Analytics
ops@clearwave.ai

On Fri, Dec 5, 2026 at 15:12, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> (attached CSV and summary)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity commissioning — verification & acceptance (internal)

Laura / Marissa — quick internal update before I send the revised checklist to ClearWave: we added a controlled pre-warm step to the rollout (preheat-kv on pool-clarity-prod-us-west) that reduces cold-path retries by approximately 4x in our replay tests. The transient OOM was due to an aggressive memory threshold on the evictor; we've relaxed that threshold for the new pool and kicked a soak for 48 hours.

I attached the acceptance-checklist.pdf stub (acceptance-checklist.pdf) which now includes:
- Warmup behavior & acceptable retry windows: retries <= 0.15% in first 3 minutes, <= 0.05% steady-state
- Failure handling: auto-restart confirmed and documented; remediation steps for persistent OOMs
- Throughput targets and measurement windows
- Post-acceptance monitoring schedule (30-day elevated + 90-day baseline)

From an infra perspective: pool-clarity-prod-us-west: 12x A100 -> reserved; autoscaler policy: sustained-queue-provisioning with burst headroom = 2 nodes; billing committed capacity amended in the draft amendment.

I'll send this to ClearWave and attach the DocuSign link for signature. Ping me if you want any additional instrumentation (trace ids are enabled under the trace/clearwave namespace).

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: acceptance-checklist.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearwave.ai>

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity commissioning — verification & acceptance

Laura / team — thank you. We've reviewed the updated checklist and confirm the mitigation language is acceptable. I just completed the DocuSign on our side (link below) and the team will monitor the 30-day elevated period as discussed.

Sign-off note: ClearWave Analytics hereby accepts the commissioned Dedicated capacity (pool-clarity-prod-us-west) and the attached acceptance checklist. We agree to the throughput guarantees and the monitoring cadence.
